retrospectiveOf.note: Restated on 2026-09-24 from the committed ENG-1021 report and evidence, without contacting any service. The original report and evidence are unchanged and remain authoritative. This is not a new run.

prompt.privateNote: The exact prompt stays in the ignored .local directory because it contains a personal filesystem path. docs/MCP-DISCOVERY.md quotes its discovery instruction. It also authorized one visit, unlike the read-only discovery-v1 prompts.

agentTools: Node.js scripts in an isolated scratch workspace
environment.network: Restricted sandbox; six network-escalated executions succeeded

route.observation: Search field says Search servers by name; API Reference links to /docs.
GET /v0.1/servers supports name substring search and latest-version filtering.
One active, latest listing: io.github.manifest-network/merovingian version 0.4.2.

endpointSelection.note: The listing supplied the Streamable HTTP endpoint; the endpoint was not guessed.

friction.description: The first unprivileged request to the registry API reference failed with EAI_AGAIN; a network-capable execution succeeded afterward.
Six network-escalated executions succeeded. The agent observed no separate human approval interaction; escalation results were not treated as user authorization.
Optional MCP GET streaming returned HTTP 405 on each of three client connections; the SDK continued with JSON POST responses.
The registry name io.github.manifest-network/merovingian differed from the negotiated server name network.manifest.merovingian/merovingian. Release 0.4.3 later aligned them.
During the run the supervising agent reported publication complete and asked for focused evidence. It did not supply the endpoint or menu.

outcome.stoppedAt: After the one authorized enjoy_amenity visit and the after-visit counter snapshot.

authorization.reference: Direct user reply "Approve publication and one test visit", recorded in docs/MCP-DISCOVERY.md

limitations: Name-led registry discovery with the registry URL supplied; not organic or capability-led discovery.
The host product and version were not recorded.
The host's MCP server configuration was not recorded.
Shared aggregate counters support the single serving without independently excluding concurrent traffic.
The attempt marker was not fsynced; the run does not demonstrate crash-safe durability.
